'''Carrion Eater''' is located in [[chapter 3]] after unlocking it from [[Lyon]], it can be found randomly in a any room except for [[Reforge Furnace|the Reforge Furnace]] and [[Shop|the Shop]]. 

if you drop any [[Spells|spell]] next to the hole, one of the tongues will reach out and take it returning you one of six unique spells.

Blast Surge
